These rods can be used variably: both average and heavy feeders can be applied without problems, both in still waters and in rivers with slow current. But what makes this particular rod truly special, is its collectible stunningly beautiful black&gold design!

name: Flaggmann™ AllRound™ PlayStation®Plus Edition Available only for PlayStation
description: Flaggmann™ AllRound™ PlayStation®Plus Edition Available only for PlayStation

name: Flaggmann™ BFFT BreamCast™
description: BFFT BreamCast™ is an exclusive picker feeder rod with collectible tournament edition design, that was created in the wake of Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour! Marvelously built for fishing with small unleaded feeders by method of short-range casting in rivers with slow current and silent waters, the BFFT BreamCast™ is a sensitive and versatile rod that can be appreciated by more advanced anglers for its sensitivity in detecting even the softest bites!

name: Flaggmann™ BFFT FrenzyRound™
description: BFFT FrenzyRound™ is a collectible feeder rod with exclusive tournament edition design, that was created especially for the Bream Feeder Frenzy Tour! Extremely versatile and reliable, this feeder rod was built with the need of less experienced anglers in mind. BFFT FrenzyRound™ feeder rod can be used variably: both average and heavy feeders can be applied without problems, both in still waters and in rivers with slow current.

name: UL-CHUBER™ Fruitcake™
description: Feeder rod Fruitcake™ by UL-CHUBER™ is delicious like a fruitcake, and wonderfully balanced! Perfect for medium-weight feeder fishing at lakes and calm rivers. It is part of the premium range of bottom rods. You should definitely check out this magnificent combination of power and distance of casting!

name: UL-CHUBER™ X-Series Whisperer™
description: This top model of the highest quality seems to mesmerize the fish, forcing it to appear among your catch in record time. This exemplary universal rod is a true dream of a professional. The model has excellent balance, sits perfectly in the hand, performs easy and accurate casts. It certainly doesn't afraid of big loads and truly large fish. Today it is actually the pinnacle of the evolution among feeder rods.

name: Garry Scott™ Ardix
description: Part of Garry Scott™ GSLex® specialized range, Ardix™ series presents new and amazingly powerful match rods with perfect casting actions and unrivaled performance capabilities. Featuring light-to-medium actioned blanks that are versatile and designed for diverse fishing, unique carbon fiber material shaped by our revolutionary FormFlex® technology along with the NFT® lightweight guides and an ergonomic secure grip handle, making the Ardix™a series of genuinely high performance match rods.

name: Garry Scott™ Brutus
description: Part of the GSLex® range, the Brutus™ is yet another beautiful series of float rods featuring well-balanced faultless action, unmatched power and an outstanding price-performance ratio. These ultra durable match rods with perfectly balanced action are versatile and designed for diverse fishing and are just the choice for those aimed at catching some big fish. The MegaResin® carbon fiber blank shaped by our revolutionary FormFlex® technology and complemented with an ergonomic secure grip handle guarantees a true high performance rod. This is a superb match rod series comes in a wide selection to suit a wide range of angling preferences.

name: Garry Scott™ Nero
description: This limited series of premium float rods belongs to our GSPlatinex® ultra top line, which means unprecedented durability, lightness and all the benefits of Garry Scott™ unique hi-end technologies. Each and every float rod from the Nero™ series is extremely lightweight and super strong. The FormFlex® shaped design of the ultra slim NanoForce® blank diameter is further enhanced by the UZZ® pattern technology to give you a superbly balanced, resilient and lightweight rod ideally suited for light to medium heavy float fishing. GSPlatinex® Nero™ series is available in three models with a wide range of options.

name: Garry Scott™ EquatorMatch™
description: If you’ve been looking for a match rod for Equatorial African fishing, the engineers at Garry Scott™ have good news for you! The new EquatorMatch™ is a small, neat, and precise tool, made incredibly reliable thanks to the unique NanoForceTitanium® ultra-lightweight and megastrong guide system. This fishing rod has amazing power, and when the size of the river fauna is impressive, this is the type of tackle to guarantee an outstanding catch!

name: RIVERTEX™ Fenix
description: An opening range of Rivermatch® high-quality float rods, the Fenix® float rod series has been made using the latest MaxCarbon® high-modulus carbon fiber alloys and ResinFix® unique curing technology to give you light blanks of significant power for optimal float angling performance. Complete with FGS® guide system and top grade cork handles for improved grip, these float rods are a superb value with plenty of power, balanced action and good line control.

name: RIVERTEX™ Majesty™
description: Majesty™ is a much-awaited new and superb addition to the Rivermatch™ premium line of match rods from Rivertex™. A high-quality versatile match rod, Majesty™ features a super light and powerful blank made with the latest MaxCarbon™ high-modulus carbon fiber alloys and ResinFix™ unique curing technology to ensure optimal angling performance. Complete with FGS™ guide system and top-grade handles for improved grip, this exceptional rod is the perfect balance between power, precision and control.

name: RIVERTEX™ SpellLauncher™
description: The elegant novelty for tropical waters by RIVERTEX™ is a classic three-piece rod for match fishing! The graphite rod is equipped with high-rise guides for an excellent line flow. This small rod with a pleasant cork handle allows you to cast real far both from the shore and from the boat. It is essential for catching large fish that prefer to keep further from the shore, like Brycon or Tambaqui.

name: Flaggmann™ OmniFloat
description: This rod series is ideal for all types of float fishing and provides excellent control over floats. The tree-piece fishing rod features a muscular and powerful extra long blank made of high modulus carbon and comes with an ergonomic screw reel seat, ceramic lined graphite guides and hybrid EVA foam grips for improved performance and comfort.

name: Garry Scott™ X-Series FireArrow™
description: This supreme performance match rod belongs to the exclusive X-Series of professional fishing tackle that is meant to be handled only by Tournament winners! And no wonder - with unmatched casting distance and paramount performance potential, this is by far the most powerful match rod ever created!

name: Garry Scott™ Nero Sport
description: Presenting the much awaited sports series of fishing rods with a chic and stylish black-n-white design that puts emphasis on the word SPORT in sportfishing! This sportfishing rod is twice as strong and durable as its original predecessor. Part of the GSPlatinex® ultra top line, the Nero™ is a limited premium series of match rods that are super lightweight and unbelievably strong. The FormFlex® advanced design of the NanoForce® slim blank is further enhanced by the UZZ® pattern technology to give you a superbly balanced, resilient and lightweight rod ideally suited for making long casts with floats. GSPlatinex® Nero™ series is available in three models with a wide range of options.

name: RIVERTEX™ Fire Fenix
description: A limited Halloween edition of Fenix™, the popular rod designed by Rivertex for match fishing. This Fenix rose from the ashes to help you catch the biggest of Halloween Monster Gars!

name: Garry Scott™ IrishClover
description: Even if you’re not that into St. Patrick’s Day, the IrishClover® match rod is one reason why you’re gonna love it this year! The special holiday blank design with cute lucky horseshoes and clovers will serve as your token of good luck that’s sure to boost your spirits up regardless of whether you consider the day to be an actual holiday! Not to mention that the lightweight design of the carbon fiber blank with perfectly balanced moderate-fast action makes the IrishClover® ideal for diverse fishing when going after trophy monsters like catfish or gar.

name: Garry Scott™ GoldPot
description: GoldPot® is a limited St. Patrick’s Day Edition match rod that’s quite a feast for the eyes! With this luckiest looking angling tool you are sure to stand out from the crowd and bring dazzling rainbow joy to the masses. While an original design makes this rod symbolize a pot of gold at the end of the rainbow, the real magic is in this rod’s fantastic characteristics! Jam packed with leading edge technologies, this tool is sure to serve you long and well, attracting your dream catches as well as admiring glances of all other anglers!

name: Garry Scott™ GreenBeer
description: Celebrate Saint Patrick’s Day with our limited edition GreenBeer® match rod, exclusively designed for the fortunate holiday occasion. This limited St. Patrick’s Day edition angling tool features an awesome flamboyant design to boost up that luck-bearing spirit! Not to mention, this is one powerful high performance rod ready to handle some heavy load float fishing! The GreenBeer® match rod is one real leprechaun trap for your trophy monster.

name: Garry Scott™ MCT McCarp™
description: Garry Scott™ presents the limited MCT tournament edition carp rod to mark the occasion of this September’s first ever Carp cyberfishing competitive event! This unique champion-potential rod is a mighty powerful fishing tool exclusively designed in the style and color theme of Mighty Carp Tour - all to make sure you’re armed with the best equipment for catching this tricky critter! Superb casting action and unrivaled performance capacity make the MCT McCarp™ carp rod an extremely versatile collectible with genuinely high performance fit for a confident Tournament winner.

name: Garry Scott™ GGC MatchMonster™
description: You are holding the limited Tournament edition match rod that was created by Garry Scott™ in the wake of Gars&Glory Cup as beastily muscular gar catching weapon! Featuring ultra powerful casting potential, well-balanced faultless action, and a lightweight blank for the most victorious performance ever, this high performance angling tool for catching the biggest monster gars also boasts exclusive GGC design that makes it a true collectible worthy of glorious Champions!

name: Garry Scott™ SCT DeepCrawler™
description: Gary Scott™ is boasting yet another limited Spring Cats Tour tournament edition of one of the most powerful match rods ever made. This exclusive tool’s unique design is stylishly branded to match the theme and colors of the SCT catfishing Tournament, this spring’s first and most exciting competitive fishing event! Not only does the DeepCrawler™ feature a brand new collectible design to die for, but is also boast unmatched casting potential to maximize the odds of landing a real trophy Cat!

name: RIVERTEX™ SkeleHand™
description: A limited Halloween edition match rod with ultra powerful action for catching some of the biggest resurrected monster gars! Spooky exclusive design makes this superb rod look like a bony arm of justice that’ll reach out and give you a haunted upper hand when match fishing for the biggest of Halloween Monster Gars!

name: Garry Scott™ ChocolateBar™
description: This match masterpiece ChocolateBar™ by the leading manufacturer of float rods GarryScott™ is not likely to melt in your hands, but will instead help you bring in really large fish! A most solid core of carbon fiber makes the rod simultaneously ultra durable, surprisingly flexible and light, while titanium guides will be sure to not let any predator go!

name: RIVERTEX™ X-Series MatchWinner
description: This classic 3-piece graphite rod from RIVERTEX™ will be presented to winners who achieve the best results in match fishing. Tall guides provide excellent line passage, while a nice and comfortable cork handle allows you to cast to the maximum distance both from the shore and from the boat. If you are a fan of large catches and prefer to stay far away from the shore, then this rod is for you!

name: RIVERTEX™ LBFC AquaBreeze™ XL
description: Designed specifically for the Live Bait Fiesta Cup, the LBFC AquaBreeze™ XL 450 match rod by Rivertex™ is a perfect example of high performance fishing tackle. The body of this extremely strong and at the same time quite flexible rod is made of a lightweight material. Thanks to the special design of the blank benefitting from the ResinFix™ technology, the rod has perfect sensitivity during retrieves and bites. In addition, the proprietary ForceGuide® technology, which ensures perfect casting accuracy and prevents rapid wear of the line, makes this rod the pinnacle of modern technology.

name: Wicked Viking
description: Forged for the bravest warriors of the Halloween seas, the Wicked Viking™ match rod features a Viking-inspired design with runes and dragon motifs, embodying the raw strength and fearless spirit of the ancient Norse. Created to defeat the strongest opponents, Wicked Viking™ is designed specifically for battling the monstrous Armored Bighead. Its powerful action and sturdy construction give you the advantage of reeling in this giant as if Odin himself is guiding your hand. Prepare to face stormy waters with courage and unleash your inner Viking this Halloween!

name: Tsurihito™ Kōdo Kyatchā
description: The Japanese company Tsurihito™ is one of the oldest and largest manufacturers developing extra heavy rods. One of them is Kōdo Kyatchā from the exclusive Kōdo series, made with SamuraiDo® technology. Eight reinforcement layers of high modulus polyethylene “gel fiber”, carbon fabric and polymer resin provide the rod with exceptional strength and amazing flexibility. This is a powerful rod with a light and strong blank, equipped with guides with silicon carbide inserts that help avoid line tangles. This unique powerful spinning rod will become an indispensable tackle for many sea fishing enthusiasts.

name: Fletch and Bradford™ BreakwaterX
description: Engineered for long-distance casting, these rods excel both from shore and boat, providing effortless control and sensitivity. Featuring DynamicCore™, the blank is constructed with advanced lightweight composites, offering excellent flexibility to absorb sudden movements without sacrificing strength. FaVector™ reinforces the rod with high-tensile polymer layers, ensuring a perfect balance between power and sensitivity—allowing anglers to detect subtle bites while maintaining complete control over their catch. With an ergonomic, non-slip EVA handle and a perfectly balanced design, this rod delivers comfort, precision, and reliability in every cast.

name: Tsurihito™ MizuJigu
description: A set of short yet powerful saltwater spinning rods designed for handling medium to large fish. Built for balance and sensitivity, they combine cutting-edge materials with advanced engineering to maximize casting efficiency and durability. Featuring HikariFlex™, these rods utilize ultra-thin graphene layers for strength, allowing anglers to detect the lightest bites while maintaining full control. TensaiCore™ reinforces the blank with multidirectional carbon fiber and nanoceramic layers, ensuring durability under extreme pressure. The TatsukoGrip™ ergonomic handle offers a secure, fatigue-free grip, making long fishing sessions more comfortable.

name: Njörinvik™ Asgard™
description: Asgard™ is a high-performance spinning rod perfectly suited for vertical jigging and dominating deep-water predators. Built on an ultra-dense carbon composite blank, it balances strength with refined sensitivity for luring predators from the depths. The BergRygg® reinforced backbone channels lifting power through the core, reducing mid-section flex during aggressive hook-ups. Frostbind® multi-layer coating protects joints and guides from salt, corrosion, and harsh temperature swings.

name: Njörinvik™ Midgard™
description: Midgard™ is a spinning rod designed for inshore and medium-action fishing with the backbone needed for vertical jigging. Built on a responsive graphite blank, it offers the perfect balance of sensitivity and control. StrikeCap® reinforcement at the tip absorbs impact from aggressive strikes and sudden hooksets, protecting the blank from stress fractures. The StødigFoam® non-slip handle coating ensures steady control in all weather, providing all-day comfort whether you're casting from shore or boat.

name: Tsurihito™ Kōdo Tatsu Umi Pro
description: The Kōdo Tatsu Umi Pro casting rod from the latest Kōdo series by the leading Japanese manufacturer Tsurihito™ will captivate casting saltwater fishing enthusiasts with its unique properties. The rod delivers exceptional balance and power while still looking sleek. The innovative technology of applying each of the eight composite reinforcing layers to the rod provides it with the highest strength and flexibility. The unique placement of the guides allows you to use not only fishing lines, but also thin braided cords without problems and overlaps.

name: Tsurihito™ Torii Dai-Kichi
description: The Torii Dai-Kichi casting rod is functional, reliable and designed with predatory sea fishing in mind. Its high-tech blank is made of a composite material carbon prepreg, which makes the rod lightweight and sensitive. The long rod handle and fairly wide butt are ergonomic and fit comfortably in the hand. The Japanese believe that the decorative ornament of the sacred Tori gate brings good luck and blessings to the owner!

name: Tsurihito™ Kōdo Kage
description: Designed for high-power offshore trolling, this saltwater casting rod delivers strength and precision for battling extra-large fish. The curved butt section provides better leverage, reducing strain during prolonged fights. Its medium length balances power and control. Built with TensaiCore™, the multi-directional carbon fiber core ensures high durability under heavy loads. The RyuKen™-reinforced tip adds strength while maintaining flexibility for precise hook sets. TatsukoGrip™ high-density EVA handle offers a secure hold, even in wet conditions. Made for deep-sea trolling, this rod is built to handle the ocean's toughest predators.

name: Fletch and Bradford™ Tri-Flex Graphite
description: Fletch and Bradford™ Tri-Flex Graphite

name: Fletch and Bradford™ MaxFlow X-treme
description: Fletch and Bradford™ MaxFlow X-treme

name: Fletch and Bradford™ Ocean Fury
description: FaBula Ocean Fury from Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) is a superb elegant trolling rod that guarantees you an unforgettable sea fishing experience! Made using FaBrilliant® technology, this rod has extraordinary flexibility and stretch with exceptional strength, as well as moisture resistance and increased anti-shock properties. In addition to powerful guides, the rod is equipped with a roller at the base of the blank and a roller tip for fishing line, made of heavy-duty material that can withstand heavy loads under extreme sea fishing conditions. This rod truly is a guarantee of fishing success!

name: Fletch and Bradford™ ReefRider Max
description: The ReefRider Max trolling rod from Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) is a masterpiece of engineering and design. Developed to perform in the toughest conditions, this rod is equipped with a complete set of roller guides and a saltwater resistant roller tip. Innovations were used in the manufacturing process, including the Ultra Resonance System® technology, as the use of composite high-modulus materials made it possible to obtain unique properties of the rod: the ability to instantly return to its original position after peak loads, plasticity, and high sensitivity!

name: Tsurihito™ Ryōshi Kaito HJ
description: The Ryōshi Kaito HJ is a powerful short rod from the leading Japanese fishing tackle manufacturer Tsurihito™. The innovative technologies used in its production make this rod a unique tackle for bottom sea fishing. The nanofibers used to reinforce the rod with NanoFlexyPoint® technology create an incredibly strong and flexible construction. The rod is equipped with a complete set of reinforced roller guides and a roller tip that can withstand heavy loads under extreme fishing conditions. All tackle is treated with a special anti-corrosion protective layer against the aggressive marine environment, which increases the performance of the rod.

name: Fletch and Bradford™ AquaStrike FJ
description: Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) has released this AquaStrike FJ short bottom rod at an attractive price. It’s perfect for fishing in conditions where it is impossible to swing far enough when casting and throw the bait far. Made with alternating layers of fiberglass, this sleek looking rod is strong enough to take on big fish. The rod is equipped with strong and reliable guides that resist unexpected and heavy loads to withstand the significant weight of the fish. The perfect combination of quality and price!

name: AquaVolt™ PulseWave™
description: PulseWave™ is a saltwater bottom casting E-ROD that features a CoreCharge® system inside the handle to power your E-REEL directly, maintaining a balanced setup even during intense battles. With SmartClick® direct-mount tech, the reel snaps into place in one smooth motion, activating power and data transfer. Reinforced by TorqueArc® architecture, PulseWave™ keeps its shape under stress, distributing force evenly and preventing torsion.

name: AquaVolt™ Chillarc™
description: Chillarc™ is a saltwater bottom casting E-ROD made of a responsive carbon-composite blank that offers excellent sensitivity and controlled flex. Equipped with the CoreCharge® integrated battery system, Chillarc™ delivers clean, uninterrupted power to your E-REEL directly through the handle. VoltSnap® charging tech keeps the internal system cool and efficient, minimizing downtime between sessions.

name: AquaVolt™ Sigma F™
description: Compact and effortlessly easy to handle, Sigma F™ is the go-to saltwater bottom casting E-ROD for casual fishing. It offers a carbon-composite blank that delivers smooth action and great feel when targeting ocean predators. The fluorescent tip enhances bite detection in low light, giving you a visual edge when fishing after dark. Equipped with SmartClick®, the reel mounts in one seamless motion with instant power and data activation. The built-in VoltSnap® charging system maximizes efficiency, keeping your rod charged and ready with minimal downtime.

name: Tsurihito™ KarasuTōha
description: Designed for challenging offshore conditions, this short yet incredibly strong rod provides maximum control over heavy fish while maintaining sensitivity for precise bait presentation. Featuring HikariFlex™ infused construction, this rod remains lightweight without compromising durability, allowing anglers to detect even the slightest movements. TensaiCore™ multi-directional carbon reinforcement ensures superior strength, handling extreme loads with ease. The ergonomic TatsukoGrip™ EVA handle provides a secure and comfortable grip, reducing fatigue during intense fights.

name: Fletch and Bradford™ Commander
description: Designed for long-distance casting and versatility, this rod excels in both boat and shore fishing. Its durable yet lightweight construction provides the perfect balance of power and sensitivity, making it ideal for targeting medium to large fish. FaVortex™ technology enhances casting accuracy by optimizing the rod's aerodynamics, ensuring smooth, controlled long-range casts. Meanwhile, FaLineFlow™ minimizes friction with precision-placed guides, improving line release and maximizing casting distance. Reinforced with corrosion-resistant components, this rod is built to withstand the toughest saltwater conditions while delivering reliable performance.

name: Katana Soul
description: Katana Soul™ is a limited edition saltwater spinning rod designed for Halloween brave anglers! Inspired by the legendary Japanese katana, this rod is adorned with intricate patterns and ancient symbols, echoing the spirit of samurai warriors. Created to combine strength and precision, it is perfect for battling the terrifying sea monster Akkorokamui. The soul of the katana lives within this rod, giving its owner the strength and courage needed to tame the ocean depths. Whether you’re braving the haunted waters or battling the monster itself, Katana Soul™ will be your reliable ally in this thrilling Halloween adventure!

name: MagFin™ FeatherLight
description: Part of our PrimeSpinn® lux line rod segment, FeatherLight™ is an ultra-light, unbelievably sensitive and yet mega durable spinning rod that allows angling with light line and small baits, yet easily handles large fish in heavy corners. Our breakthrough AirLight® Technology combined with a state of the art GLR® graphene lining reinforcement ensure unseen precision and balance along with optimized action. Complete with world’s most lightweight LGT® guides and our breakthrough EZGuide® system, this is the ultimate high-performance ultra-light spinning rod on the market!

name: MagFin™ JigWinner
description: Part of the UltraSpinn® line, this leading edge rod series is designed to be fished with jigs. All JigWinner™ rods are light-weight and powerful with medium to light action, perfect for use with high speed and super power reels, like MagFin Prima series. The innovative ProSpeed® Construction ensures incredible lightness, and sensitivity along with muscular pulling power and fast recovery rate for jigging action like never before.

name: MagFin™ Elemental
description: Part of the StartSpinn® basic spinning rod line, Elemental™ is a multi-functional versatile spinning rod series perfect for beginner anglers. These high quality reliable rods proudly bear the MagFin name thus ensuring great performance despite their affordability. The strong and durable ProSpeed® blank complimented by the lightness of LGT® guides and superb line control of our unique EZGuide® system give you the strength and feel of a high performance spinning rod.

name: MagFin™ Aguarayo™
description: This short spinning rod with a powerful cast was developed by MagFin™ to take into account all the aspects of fishing in the Amazon and other South American waterways. Its small size allows you to make easy casts from a boat, and the rod has more than enough power to take on aggressive Amazon predators. This spinning rod is characterized by its ability to cast heavy lures for especially large fish.

name: MagFin™ RiverSpear
description: MagFin is proud to present its new unique model, which can easily overshadow all other models! This lightweight spinning rod is reinforced with state-of-the-art GLR® graphene fibers, allowing you to tackle even the biggest prey without the risk of breaking the blank. In addition, the use of a unique guides arrangement with the help of the innovative EZGuide® System technology allows you to make casts that are unprecedented in terms of range and quality. This rod is the perfect combination of strength, weight, and ease of use!

name: Garry Scott™ Aurora

The special FormFlex® rod shaping technique ensures superb actions and increased casting distance. Each GSPro® Aurora™ rod is an exquisite delight for any angler designed to achieve casting excellence.

name: RIVERTEX™ Thora

Complete with a lightweight reel seat, FGS Light® guides, quality EVA foam handles and a beautiful glossy finish to top it all, this rod has got the looks to match its fantastic performance!

name: RIVERTEX™ Loki

Complete with a lightweight reel seat, FGS Light® guides, premium-grade EVA handles and a beautiful glossy finish to top it all, this rod has got the looks to match its fantastic performance!

name: RIVERTEX™ Zeus
description: RIVERTEX™ is happy to present Zeus®, the new and most powerful member of the specialized Spinntex® line of ultra high performance spinning rods. name: RIVERTEX™ Thetis™
description: Rivertex™ presents Thetis™ - the new and most powerful yet spinning rod that bears the name of a mighty sea goddess! name: Flaggmann™ ValueSpin
description: The ValueSpin® rods are a balance of durability, quality and price – a combination that gives you the best value and comfortable performance in spinning rods. Combining a lightweight high modulus graphite blank with quality EVA foam handles, the ValueSpin® rod series is perfect for all bait applications. You’ll love it for its unique combination of affordability, strength and sensitivity.

name: RIVERTEX™ NileChasseur™
description: Rivertex™ presents its incredible spinning rod NileChasseur™, designed specifically for enormous Nile Perch specimens. The company’s signature MaxCarbon® technology has greatly amplified these characteristics, allowing the NileChasseur™ to reliably handle hefty fish. Thanks to the proven ResinFix® curing process, this African beast can help you land trophies of any weight.

description: This perfectly balanced feeder reel by UL-CHUBER™, designed specifically for the World Cats Cup, is sure to become an indispensable aid for every bottom fishing tournament participant! The waterproof front drag system, impressive durability, and ease of use will allow you to fully concentrate on winning.

description: To resist the evil spirits that broke into our world on Halloween, you need the best equipment. The Ossibus Green 8500 reel matches the Femur 385 rod perfectly. Celtic oak, ancient bones, and the magical power of runes make it an excellent tool in the fight against otherworldly monsters!

The StraighLine™ system prevents any spool play, and the unique HydroStop™ technology will protect the bearings from moisture, which will allow you to fish freely in any weather!

name: UL-CHUBER™ X-Series TornadoMax
description: This is one of the best bottom reels UL-CHUBER™ has ever created for tournament winners! It combines elegance of design with impressive power and winding speed. Lightweight high-tech spool in a durable aluminum frame, reliable draw handle, balanced graphite rotor, perfect line lay that prevents tangling, waterproof drag with AquaStop™ technology — what else can an angler ask for?

name: MagFin™ X-Series HeavyStar
description: This MagFin™ reel for tournament champions is perfect for all types of heavy lure casting. Its balanced rotor, shortened narrow profile spool that eliminates any backlash, an advanced line laying system, and a waterproof drag system make this reel extra effective for catching even very large fish. Its strong core and additional protective elements will provide durability, reliability, and convenience in use.

name: UL-CHUBER™ LBFC Jetstream
description: A sleek yet incredibly powerful UL-CHUBER™ bottom reel custom designed for the Live Bait Fiesta Cup. The LBFC Jetstream 11000 is a lightweight, fast and strong reel with a graphite body. Its waterproof front friction brake constructed with AquaStop™ technology delivers flawless performance and is capable of handling loads of up to 32 kilograms. Isn't this the dream of every professional angler? Don’t forget about a comfortable handle, a smooth spool stroke, and no backlash — and you got yourself a perfect reel!

name: RIVERTEX™ LBFC StreamRunnerPro
description: Specifically for the Live Bait Fiesta Cup tournament, Rivertex™ has developed a heavy-duty LBFC StreamRunnerPro 5500 spinning reel, which turns landing especially large fish into an enjoyable pastime! The combination of a light body with a powerful spool, as well as the use of modern technologies for line laying, maximum accuracy, and casting control, make this reel the ultimate assistant in hunting big and hardy fish. It has a huge margin of safety and bearings protection against moisture ingress, made using proprietary HydroStop™ technology, which guarantees successful fishing in any weather and victory!

name: Savanna Spirit
description: Savanna Spirit™ spinning reel unveils the ancient power of the African savannah this Halloween! Designed for precise control and maximum durability, Savanna Spirit™ pairs perfectly with the Tribal Totem™ rod. Its smooth casting and powerful drag system ensure that no monster, no matter how strong, will escape. With its bold tribal design and flawless performance, Savanna Spirit™ immerses you in the primal energy of the savannah, empowering you to conquer dark waters and triumph in your Halloween adventure!

name: Nordic Beast
description: Unleash your inner warrior this Halloween with the limited edition Nordic Beast™ spinning reel! Inspired by the fierce spirit of the Vikings, this reel combines strength and powerful performance, perfectly complementing the Wicked Viking™ rod. Adorned with Viking runes and dragon engravings, the Nordic Beast™ offers unmatched stability and control, making it ideal for conquering even the mightiest underwater foes. With this reel in hand, you’ll feel the raw power of the northern warriors as you face the stormy seas and reel in the monstrous Armored Bighead. Let the spirit of the Vikings guide you in this ultimate Halloween fishing adventure!

name: Scarlet Thread
description: Crafted for those who demand both power and accuracy, this reel strikes the perfect balance between speed and torque. The robust front drag system allows you to reel in your catch efficiently. This reel ensures ultra-smooth and comfortable operation even under heavy loads, making it versatile for various fishing scenarios. Designed to pair seamlessly with the Black Needle 230 spinning rod—just as a needle and thread go together—and to pay homage to traditional Ukrainian embroidery crafted with black and red threads.

name: Tsurihito™ Tsunami Koiru
description: This powerful spinning reel Tsunami Koiru, made by the leading manufacturer of fishing tackle, the Japanese company Tsurihito™, has a fairly large size but is easy to operate and doesn’t require special care. Being one of the most reliable reels in its class, it fully meets all the main requirements of a modern angler. A special boron nitride coating on the various 3D-BN® reel mechanisms guarantees exceptional strength, durability, and wear resistance.

name: Tsurihito™ Tengu Kai
description: This saltwater spin reel is designed for smooth, effortless retrievals under extreme strains. Its full metal body ensures strength and stability under heavy loads. The KaijutsuShield™ corrosion-resistant sealing protects internal components from saltwater and debris, guaranteeing long-term reliability. Additionally, Shinobi™ silent gear alignment minimizes noise and vibration for an ultra-smooth experience. Whether battling big fish offshore or enduring rough waters, this reel is built to perform.

name: Fletch and Bradford™ BossCast
description: Designed for versatility, these durable saltwater spin reels are perfect for long-distance casting and handling medium to large fish. The combination of TorqueFlow™ technology for smooth torque under heavy loads and HydroLock™ sealing for unmatched water resistance ensures flawless performance in all conditions. With a lightweight construction and advanced balance provided by FaBalancePro™, these reels offer reliability, comfort, and precision for extended fishing sessions.

name: Fletch and Bradford™ XCurrent
description: This saltwater spin reel delivers consistent power and smooth performance under extreme conditions. FaLight™ aerospace-grade aluminum construction keeps it lightweight yet durable, reducing fatigue on long trips. TorqueFlow™ precision-machined gears provide consistent torque, ensuring seamless power transfer when fighting fish. For ultimate protection, HydroLock™ triple-layer sealing safeguards internal components from salt, water, and debris, extending the reel’s lifespan.

name: Tsurihito™ JigokuTen
description: JigokuTen™ saltwater spin reel combines durability and precision. Its lightweight construction ensures easy handling, making it ideal for long fishing sessions. Designed for small to medium-sized fish, it features RyuGear™ multi-layered steel gears for smooth power transfer and KaijutsuShield™ triple-layer corrosion protection to withstand tough marine environments. JigokuTen™ is a perfect mix of durability and sensitivity for jigging.

name: Fletch and Bradford™ TitanGolda LWR
description: The well-known American company Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) introduces the new TitanPro Golda LWR reel for beginner anglers, which can be used for trolling small marine fish. Equipped with a line-layer and a spool release switch, it is a fairly powerful and affordable reel. The FaBula® technology guarantees high-quality protection against the aggressive effects of seawater. The StopWet® moisture-proof insulating gasket, AntiRust® anti-corrosion bearings, as well as the additional FullCover® protection of gears and mechanisms from dust, sand, and salt, ensure the trouble-free service of this reel!

name: Fletch and Bradford™ FlowCatch
description: The American company Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) has manufactured this FlowCatch saltwater baiting reel specifically for anglers for whom reliability is the main requirement in saltwater fishing. It possesses huge free-floating spool capacity, AntiRust® protected instantaneous anti-reverse brake bearing, StopWet® waterproof gasket, and other benefits of FaBula® protection technology. The lightness and strength of the body combined with the power and smoothness in reeling in the largest marine dwellers puts it ahead of any other reels of this class!

name: Fletch and Bradford™ AtlantisElite
description: The Atlantis Elite marine multiplier trolling reel from the well-known Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) company without line-layer and spool release button has one handle, a large spool capacity, a drag adjustment lever, and a speed switch. This reel can withstand heavy load and deliver maximum stopping power, as well as smooth and even DoubleTooth® drag that lasts throughout the fight. The steel-carbon brake system is highly reliable, has a long service life, is not afraid of overheating and is fully protected thanks to FaBula® technology. This firmly places this reel in the category of premium gear.

name: Fletch and Bradford™ AquaTrekker
description: The AquaTrekker reel from the well-known sea fishing tackle manufacturer Fletch and Bradford™ (FaB) is of interest not only for sea trolling experts, but also for beginner anglers. The reel has a line-layer and is designed for catching medium-sized marine fish. The FaBallance® technology perfectly balances the rotor, completely eliminating its vibrations, which in turn ensures speed, winding quality, and ease of use. A high-quality waterproof and anti-corrosion coating provides this reel with strength and durability.

name: Tsurihito™ TsuruOcean LP
description: The TsuruOcean LP from the Japanese company Tsurihito™ is a low profile saltwater baitcasting reel that you can trust 100%. This reel easily and smoothly overcomes the resistance of heavy loads, which allows you to cast both weightless plastic lures and heavy ones with accuracy, and also increases the casting distance with less effort. The spool, rotor and parts of the drag mechanisms of the reel, made using the innovative TatsumakiLite® technology from an ultra-light and strong alloy, are wear-resistant and provide high-speed winding. It has a waterproof body that is resistant to the aggressive marine environment.

Bread
description: Bread is one of the most popular and simple fishing baits used in angling. In fact, of all the possible baits in the arsenal of today’s angler, bread is probably the oldest and yet the most effective trick. It is used in fishing both as hook bait and as a groundbait. If used the right way, bread can be the kind of bait that is second to none.

name: Cheese
description: Cheese is a well know bait among anglers. Using cheese as fishing bait is fairly simple. Although it doesn’t matter which type of cheese you use, since the fish aren’t exactly picky when it comes to dairy products, strong smelling cheeses (like Danish Blue or Blue Stilton) are more preferable.

name: Corn
description: Corn is one of the most effective and cheapest freshwater bait. This bait is so versatile that it's at home for catching various species from trout to sunfish. It is also a bait that will entice big fish, so if you are being pestered by minnows but know that bigger fish is there, then corn could be the answer.

name: Dough Ball
description: Dough Ball fish bait is simple to make and can attract a variety of freshwater fish species. Everyone can prepare this excellent old-school bait. The only thing you need is a bit of flour and a cup of water. Easy to prepare, dough balls may be made ahead of time and kept in a zippered plastic bag in the refrigerator for a week or more.

name: Marshmallow
description: Marshmallow have long been a secret weapon for fishermen. Almost all freshwater fish will strike on this uncommon bait. However, because they have a relatively high air content, marshmallows have the tendency to float.

name: Peas
description: Peas is one of the best baits for Carp. It is high in protein and fiber and this is what carp and other big fish like most about this bait.

name: Pet Food
description: Pet Food Many anglers use canned dog and cat food to chum baitfish, but it’s also a good bait for various fish species. This bait is the most effective for bottom-feeding fish.

name: Semolina Balls
description: Semolina Balls is a popular fishing bait. Like dough balls, it is a good natural meal for almost all freshwater fish. Under certain conditions, semolina balls could be much more effective than ordinary dough balls.

name: Pearl Barley
description: Pearl Barley A traditional bait used by anglers since days of old. And for all the good reasons too! This effective alternative to more expensive baits is simply adored by Roach, Crucian Carp, Common Rudd and many other fish.

name: Bread with Honey
description: Bread with Honey Simple and easy to prepare, this delicious sticky paste made out brown bread and honey will do wonders when used as bait for going after most coarse fish species.

name: Sweet corn
description: Sweet corn is of the best baits for going after all species of Carp. It is also easy for fish to spot thanks to its bright yellow color.

name: Sweet Peas
description: Sweet Peas Another popular vegetal alternative to sweet corn, sweet peas are great bait for feeder fishing, particularly when going after fish like all Carp species and large Common Bream.

name: Vegetables
description: Vegetables A simple and effective bait that will work great for feeder fishing, particularly when aiming to catch fish like Silver Carp or Bighead Carp.

name: Pea dough
description: Pea dough Made out of peas and semolina, this pea dough is the most versatile bait for feeder fishing, that will do wonders for attracting Crucian Carp, Bream, European Carp, large Roach and practically all coarse fish species.

name: Camu-Camu
description: Camu-Camu . The extremely sour taste of this fruit does not please the human palate, but the fresh camu-camu is used as great bait for fishing.

name: Rubber Tree Seeds
description: Rubber Tree Seeds These seeds come from rubber trees (Hevea brasiliensis), each one looks like a large seedpod with three egg-shaped kernels inside a hard shell. This is a truly gourmet item for local fish!

name: Jauari Palm Fruit
description: Jauari Palm Fruit (Astrocaryum jauari) have juicy flesh and a large stone seed inside. This delicious treat is especially favored by frugivorous fish.

name: Moriche Palm Fruit
description: Moriche Palm Fruit Local crafters make juice, jam and even wine out of moriche palm fruit. But we are mainly interested in its abilities to attract herbivorous fish. They love this sweet dessert and can sense it from far under the water.

name: Banana bread
description: Banana bread pellets make an excellent bait for most African non-predatory fish. This treat is especially favored by the Banded Tilapia and Nile Tilapia.

name: Oat-flakes
description: Oat-flakes Some simply steam oatmeal, and some make a thick porridge. However you cook it, most non-predatory fish won’t resist such a bait!

name: Curd Dough
description: Curd Dough A thick plastic substance made from cottage cheese, honey, flour, or bread, and cooked on fire, can be used as bait for many non-predatory fish.

name: Bloodworms
description: Bloodworms are sometimes called the “ultimate fish bait." They are extremely effective as bait and play a vital role in the natural diet of numerous fish species, particularly due to their high protein content. This makes bloodworms exceptionally attractive for many fish species.

name: Crickets
description: Crickets make great bait for catching a variety of fish including bass, trout, and all kinds of pan-fish such as bluegill. Crickets can sometimes attract fish that other types of baits cannot. Probably the most effective overall bait for bluegills and trout.

name: Dragonfly
description: Dragonfly have been used by anglers as bait for years being an excellent bait for many top-water species, such as bass, trout and salmon.

name: Flies
description: Flies get blown into the water, during summertime, and fish are often found near the bank waiting for them. If you have a net you can round up plenty of flies for bait. The advantage of using flies is that they work well both dead or alive.

name: Grasshoppers
description: Grasshoppers are an easy live bait to work with due to their large size and being relatively easy to catch. Using grasshoppers as live fishing bait takes practice and some trial and error to learn the techniques that work for different fish and fishing spots.

name: Leeches
description: Leeches are an excellent live freshwater bait for walleye, catfish and northern pike. What is more, if you are looking for the perfect catfish bait then look no further. Leeches can be found in various types of lakes, farm ponds and streams.

name: Maggots
description: Maggots are a perfect coarse bait, arguably the best bait to ensure a catch even on the worst of fishing days. By throwing free offerings of maggots (feeding) into the water around a baited hook, fish are attracted to the area, which substantially increases the chance of success. Great bait for a whole variety of fish.

name: MayFlies
description: MayFlies are used by anglers for years, being known as the number one most popular and effective trout bait in the world.

name: Night Crawler
description: Night Crawler , the reddish-gray-colored common earthworm, is familiar to anyone with a fishing rod or a garden. They are indigenous to Europe, but are now abundant in North America and Western Asia.

name: Red Worms
description: Red Worms are known under various common names such as brandling worms, panfish worms, trout worms, tiger worms or red wiggler worms. The red worms is one of the traditional baits that have been used for hundreds of years.

name: Wax Worms
description: Wax Worms are the answer if you are looking for effective panfish bait. They are the bait of choice to fill your stringer in no time. Also are known to be the best grub-bait and are particularly effective for trout fishing.

name: Pinkies
description: Pinkies . A smaller version of an all-time favorite maggot bait, pinkies are the larva of the common green bottle fly. Works as great fishing bait, particularly when going after fish like Roach, Blue Bream, Silver Bream and White-eye Bream.

name: Caster Maggots
description: Caster Maggots . A great bait for coarse fishing, casters are the stages in the growth of a maggot that already contains the soon-to-emerge fly. Slightly smaller and more rounded in shape than maggots, casters work as great feeder bait for many fish species.

name: Yellow Maggots
description: Yellow Maggots . Lively and fresh, these yellow maggots are a popular choice for bottom fishing among coarse anglers and will work particularly great bait when going after fish like Bream and many other species.

name: Red Maggots
description: Red Maggots . Plump, juicy, fresh and bright red in color, these red maggots are great bait for coarse fishing. Particularly effective when going after large Bream and smaller Roach.

name: Mole Cricket Larva
description: Mole Cricket Larva . Fresh and supple, this larvae of the mole crickets is an extremely effective bait that is an irresistible yummy treat for Catfish and European Chub.

name: Centipedes
description: Centipedes . Centipedes are a versatile alternative to most other insect baits that will work great for catching practically all coarse fish species.

name: Cockchafer
description: Cockchafer . An all-time favorite among anglers, cockchafers are a marvelous insect bait for catching fish like European Chub and Asp.

name: Dobsonfly Larva
description: Dobsonfly Larva . Dobsonflies are the largest known flying insects. Their larvae are so big that they are part of the diet of some Amazon indigenous peoples. And fish just go crazy over dobsonflies!

name: Dobsonfly
description: Dobsonfly An impressive giant of a fly, this insect does a great job of attracting local fish, who consider it a delicious treat!

name: Blue-Winged Grasshopper
description: The Blue-Winged Grasshopper is so huge that many mistake it for a locust. Its bright wings are great at attracting surface-dwelling fish, such as Apapa. At the same time it’s weighty enough to be used for distance casts.

name: Giant Silk Moth Larva
description: Giant Silk Moth Larva . This is a larva of a giant silk moth. It’s large, fleshy and bright, which makes it a delicacy of choice for the catfish and other omnivorous fish.

name: Caddis Larva
description: Caddis Larva is an excellent small bait for all nonpredatory bottom-feeding fish. It can be especially successful in attracting the Bulldog Fish, Elephant Fish, and smaller specimens of the African Big Eye Catfish and Congo Yellowfish.

name: African Giant Water Bug
description: African Giant Water Bug Try using this giant bug as a bait when pursuing African catfish species, and you’ll be impressed! This insect predator can reach over 10 cm in length, and smaller specimens of the African Sharptooth Catfish, Vundu Catfish, or Kamba Catfish simply can’t ignore it.

name: Bark Beetle Larva
description: Bark Beetle Larva This large and heavy curved larva is not only a woodpecker's favorite delicacy, but also an excellent bait for many fish. It can reach a length of 4 to 7 centimeters and is the best delicacy for those fish that feed near the surface of the water.

name: Crawling Worm and Selective Crawling worm
description: Crawling Worm and Selective Crawling worm Thanks to its high flexibility and considerable size, the crawling worm makes an ideal bait for catching large fish. It is effectively used together with different types of hooks, which significantly raises the chances of a successful catch. This bait performs especially well in muddy and overgrown waters, where Catfish dwell and feed.

name: Mole Cricket and Selective Mole Cricket
description: Mole Cricket and Selective Mole Cricket Mole cricket is an insect with a hard exoskeleton and juicy body. Its natural smell is effective at attracting predators. The mole cricket is considered one of the best baits for catching Catfish and other large fish.

name: Artificial Salmon Eggs
description: Artificial Salmon Eggs are made from soft plastic and with their realistic look, in some cases, can be even more effective than real Salmon/Trout Eggs.

name: Blood
description: Blood was, for long time, an undisclosed secret of real catfish anglers. This bait work very well on blue catfish or channel catfish, especially in waters with a current.

name: Crawfish
description: Crawfish rank among the best baits for fishing in small rivers and ponds. It works great for catching both Smallmouth and Largemouth Bass, especially in spring and summer. Not to mention that most species of catfish feed on crawfish as well.

name: Crawfish Cuts
description: Crawfish Cuts will spread a tasty scent in the water, attracting Smallmouth and Largemouth Bass, especially in warm days of spring or summer. Sunken deeper, could be an irresistible attraction for most species of catfish.

name: Frogs
description: Frogs and tadpoles are excellent bait for catching Largemouth Bass as well as Smallmouth Bass and Butterfly Peacock Bass. Toads are also great bait for catching catfish.

name: Large Cutbait
description: Large Cutbait - cut, sliced, or squashed from a natural baitfish - allows the release of organic juices into the water. A natural bait, immediately recognizable by catfish as food in a natural sense. These big slices of fish will attract monsters!

name: Large Minnow
description: Large Minnow was always use as one of the most effective baits for catching big predators. It's the perfect choice for catching multiple game fish like pike, bass or salmon. Just make sure to choose heavy tackle when you want to use them!

name: Medium Cutbait
description: Medium Cutbait is a small fillet from a large baitfish, a natural bait that releases organic juices into the water. Great for catfish and smaller species.

name: Small Cutbait
description: Small Cutbait resemble with the left-overs from big fish hunts. Small or medium-sized fish are crazy about them. Small pieces from a large baitfish makes great cutbaits for catfish and smaller panfish.

name: Natural Eggs
description: Natural Eggs are highly productive bait for trout and salmon. The effectiveness of a salmon egg depends on two things: the quality of the egg, and the egg cure. The popularity of this bait has always been quite high among trout and salmon anglers. In fact, so high that hook manufacturers went to the trouble of designing hooks specifically for use with salmon eggs.

name: Shiners
description: Shiners are regarding by many fishermen as one of the most effective bait. It's perfect choice for catching multiple game fish like pike, bass, salmon and trout.

name: Small Minnows
description: Small Minnows are regarded by many fishermen as one of the most effective baits. It's the perfect choice for catching bass, crappie, perch or pickerel.

name: Spawn Sacks
description: Spawn Sacks with Salmon or Trout eggs are one of the most effective baits for going after Salmon, Steelhead and Trout. In fact, spawning fish may sometimes ignore all other baits.

name: Duck Mussel Meat
description: Duck Mussel Meat . A traditionally popular bait among coarse anglers, duck mussels are molluscs that are an excellent choice for attracting fish like Tench, Carp and Catfish.

name: Technoplankton
description: Technoplankton . A special dry-pressed fishing bait made from natural ingredients, technoplankton is the ultimate choice for feeder fishing, particularly when going after Bighead Carp and Silver Carp.

name: Aracu Minnow
description: Aracu Minnow . This tiny fish is the favourite food among Amazon predators. Use Aracu Minnow to get best results when fishing for large predator species.

name: Dead Lambari Fish
description: Dead Lambari Fish . They say dead fish is of little use to anyone. They are wrong! It can still serve as a bait for larger fish.

name: Meat Chunk
description: Meat Chunk . Everybody knows that piranhas love raw meat. But don't be surprised when you see how many other jungle fish species would love to feast on this bait.

name: Chicken Liver
description: The smell of the raw Chicken Liver is so strong that it travels far even in the water. It should attract catfish and perhaps other carnivorous fish.

name: Freshwater Prawns
description: Freshwater Prawns . The small size of these freshwater prawns makes them the favourite food for large and especially for small fish of the Amazon basin.

name: Huge Cutbait
description: Huge Cutbait Cutbait is natural bait, just the kind catfish immediately recognize as food in its natural sense. Either cut, sliced, or squashed from a natural baitfish, cutbait releases organic juices into the water. This is an excellent lure for large predators!

name: Large Liver
description: Large Liver The smell of the raw liver is so strong that it travels far even in the water. It should attract catfish and perhaps other carnivorous fish.

name: Freshwater Crab
description: Freshwater Crab Local underwater predators are so tough, that no crab shell can stop them. A crab is a real delicacy for them, and they are ready to eat it alive. But when it’s started to smell, it becomes simply irresistible!

name: Banded Aracu
description: The Banded Aracu is a small fish inhabiting Amazonian waterways. It’s the favorite delicacy of large predators like the huge Peacock Bass.

name: Amazonian Sardine
description: If you want to attract small Amazonian predators like Jacunda or Biara, the Amazonian Sardine is your best choice! This tiny elongated fish makes its carnivorous siblings bite as never before.

name: Buffalo Kidneys
description: Buffalo Kidneys When truly big African catfish are at stake, bring out the heavy artillery! Buffalo Kidneys are great at attracting the largest specimens of the African Sharptooth Catfish, Vundu Catfish, or Kamba Catfish.

name: Small Tilapia
description: Small Tilapia The image of this small member of the Cichlid family can be found in Ancient Egyptian writings. What’s more, it makes a wonderful large bait for all predator fish, especially the Nile Perch and the Tigerfish.

name: Canned Meat
description: If African catfish species are your main target, be sure to grab some Canned Meat . Its characteristic smell does a great job attracting these fish from long distances away.

name: Sideswimmers
description: Sideswimmers These small shrimp-like crustaceans are about 1 cm in length. The Baikal sideswimmer is an excellent bait for many types of fish, especially Whitefish. Since it is the basis of the diet of the Omul, huge flocks of this fish are drawn to where the sideswimmers are gathered.

name: Boiled Red Roe
description: Boiled Red Roe Boiled red caviar makes an ideal bait for all medium-sized Salmon. Boiled caviar loses its characteristic taste, and starts looking like a whitish gelatin ball.

name: Common Minnow
description: Common Minnow This small schooling fish makes an excellent bait for most predatory fish. Its weight doesn’t exceed 20 grams, and its length is usually less than 20 centimeters.

name: Salo and Salo Generalske
description: Salo and Salo Generalske Salo, or salt-cured pork fat, is not only a Ukrainian traditional dish, but also a wonderful bait for carp fishing. Fat and thick when cut, it stays reliably on the hook and emits a smell that attracts Common and Grass Carps. This bait is most effective in warm weather, when the fat actively releases its aroma.

name: Shrimps
description: Shrimps are a hard to be ignored bait for almost any fish. Bass, Panfish, Trout or Catfish loves them.

name: Clam Meat
description: Clam Meat . A genuine delicacy that will leave no fish indifferent, clam meat comes from tiny shellfish that are even smaller than mussels and is a superb choice of saltwater bait!

name: Mussel Meat
description: Mussel Meat . Soft, juicy and fresh out of the Gulf of Mexico, this deliciously irresistible mussel meat is one of the best fish baits, particularly when going after saltwater monsters!

name: Crab
description: Crab . A gourmet dish for humans and fish alike, this crab is a deliciously irresistible bait that does wonders at attracting predators in salty and brackish waters!

name: Sand Fleas
description: Sand Fleas . These tiny crustaceans that like to burrow in the sand of coastal swash zones are a super versatile and effective bait for saltwater fishing!

name: Sea Worms
description: Sea Worms . Perhaps, the most versatile choice of saltwater bait, sea worms will work great for catching practically any fish.

name: Gulf Shrimp
description: Gulf Shrimp . A yummy treat for absolutely any fish species, this fresh and juicy critter straight from the waters of the Gulf of Mexico is larger than any ordinary shrimp and an excellent choice for bait when fishing in seawater.

name: Scaled Sardines
description: Scaled Sardines . These small herring-like fish, native to the Gulf of Mexico, are a perfect choice of bait when going after vicious predators, particularly in this saltwater region.

name: Finger Mullets
description: Finger Mullets . Predatory fish can go into feeding frenzy when they come across schools of delicious finger mullets. No wonder these small inhabitants of brackish water areas are such a popular bait for saltwater fishing!

name: Japanese Spiny Lobster
description: Japanese Spiny Lobster This small spiny lobster reaches up to 30 cm long and can be found in the Pacific Ocean near the coasts of Japan, Taiwan, China, and Korea. It’s a valuable commercial crustacean in Japan, while also making a perfect bait for the Giant Grouper.

name: Japanese flying squid
description: The Japanese flying squid got its name from its ability to jump out of the water and fly a short distance above the surface. This small squid is perfect for baiting Snappers, Bonitos, Mackerels, Marlins, and Tunas.

name: Japanese Jack Mackerel
description: Japanese Jack Mackerel . This is a relatively large forage fish. In sports fishing, it makes an excellent bait for all pelagic predatory fish such as Tunas, Marlins, Mackerels, Bonitos, Yellowtails, and Trevallies. The average size of the Japanese Jack Mackerel is 20–35 centimeters.

name: Japanese Anchovy
description: Japanese Anchovy . This small forage fish is popular in Japanese and Korean cuisine, as well as makes excellent bait for all predatory marine pelagic fish such as small Tunas, small Marlins, Mackerels, Bonitos, Yellowtails, and Trevallies.

name: Gutted Fish
description: Gutted Fish . A gutted carcass of a small mackerel fish. It’s believed that the smell of gutted fish attracts predators faster. Its head can be fitted on one or two large hooks to make an excellent bait for Groupers, Snappers, or Sharks.

name: Medium Fish Strips
description: Medium Fish Strips . A medium-sized piece of fish meat with skin, cut into a strip along the spine. It’s mounted on one hook so that the sharp point is free. This is an excellent bait for Snappers, Trevallies, Greater Amberjack, and Small Grouper.

name: Large Fish Strips
description: Large Fish Strips . A large piece of fish meat with skin, cut into a strip along the spine. It’s mounted on one hook so that the sharp point is free. This is an excellent bait for Snappers, Trevallies, Greater Amberjack, Groupers, and Sharks.

name: Flying Fish
description: Flying Fish . A relatively small fish, perfect for a livebait trolling rig when targeting small to medium pelagic species. Widely recognized as a favorite prey for Tuna, Mahi-Mahi, and Marlin.

name: Large Flying Fish
description: Large Flying Fish . An extra-large Flying Fish, offering a bigger meal for pelagic predators. Its size makes it an ideal choice for targeting large Tuna and Marlin. Perfect for a livebait trolling rig.

name: Indian Ocean Squid
description: Indian Ocean Squid . A relatively small squid, used for a livebait trolling rig, native to the Indian and western Pacific Oceans, typically found in shallow waters. As a highly versatile bait, it attracts a variety of large saltwater predators, including Tuna, Marlin, Wahoo, and Mahi-Mahi.

name: Split Tail Mullet
description: Split Tail Mullet . This middle-sized mullet is specially cut along its body to enhance its movement during trolling. The modified tail creates a natural fluttering action, making the bait appear more lifelike in the water. It's an excellent choice for trolling all pelagic fish with a livebait trolling rig.

name: Fish Head
description: Fish Head . This fresh tuna head slowly releases its natural oils into the water, making it an irresistible target for voracious saltwater predators. A solid pick for bottom fishing.

name: Tuna Fish Heads
description: Tuna Fish Heads . Chunky, bony tuna heads. The Butcher Shark loves crunching on a snack like this.

name: Giant Tiger Prawn
description: Giant Tiger Prawn . Found throughout the warm waters of the Indo-Pacific region, this large shrimp is easily recognized by its bold black stripes. Its impressive size and firm texture make it an incredibly versatile bait, attracting a wide range of saltwater fish.

name: Indo-Pacific Swimming Crab
description: Indo-Pacific Swimming Crab . A favorite snack for bottom predators, such as Groupers, Snappers, and Sickle Pomfret. Its natural appeal makes it a go-to bait for fishing near reefs and sandy shallows.

name: Natal Rock Oyster Meat
description: Natal Rock Oyster Meat . Growing on submerged rocks and harbor walls, this oyster is a favorite snack for many bottom fish. Its fresh meat makes it an effective and versatile bait.

name: Filamentous Red Algae
description: Filamentous Red Algae . Filamentous Red Algae is like an ocean salad bar for herbivorous fish! A Sleek Unicornfish especially can’t resist it.

name: Luminous Flying Fish
description: Luminous Flying Fish . Flying Fish are perfect as live bait for trolling smaller and mid-sized pelagic species, but the luminous ones are especially flattering for the legendary Night Windrazor. Their brilliance is so dazzling that it effortlessly attracts the attention of this rapid hunter.

name: Atlantic Herring
description: Atlantic Herring . Atlantic Herring is a large live bait fish and one of the most popular go-to choices in the North Atlantic. Its oily flesh provides rich nutrition, while the shiny scales reflect light underwater, mimicking the flash of a fleeing baitfish. Favored by top predators like Halibut, Atlantic Cod, Coalfish, Common Ling, Atlantic Salmon, and especially European Hake, it's a versatile option for saltwater fishing.

name: Lesser Sand Eel
description: Lesser Sand Eel . Lesser Sand Eel is a slender, wriggly live bait favored by many bottom-dwelling and mid-water saltwater predators. In the North Atlantic, few baits match its versatility for tempting small- to medium-sized predators such as Cod-like fish, Halibut, Trout and many others, especially around sandy bottoms where Sand Eels naturally gather.

name: Atlantic Mackerel Сut Baits
description: Atlantic Mackerel Сut Baits . Large, oily chunks of mackerel that hold up well on the hook thanks to their tough texture. Its high fat content creates a strong scent trail in the water, making it a top choice when targeting saltwater hunters like Flatfish, Norway Seaperch, and European Angler.

name: Bluey
description: Bluey . A whole bait fish without the head and tail, split along the backbone, and partly turned inside out before being tied with thread for a secure hold. Its rich scent and oils make it a fantastic choice for big bottom-dwelling fish like Halibut, Spiny Dogfish, European Sea Sturgeon, and others.

name: Seal Blubber
description: Seal Blubber . Thick chunks of seal fat, rich in oils and nutrients. As the scent slowly spreads through the water, it sends an irresistible signal to Greenland Sharks, driving them to seek out this calorie-packed meal. Ready to face a giant like this? Then seal blubber is the bait to choose!

name: Ragworms
description: Ragworms . Ragworms are common marine worms found across the North Atlantic. They live in shallow coastal areas with muddy or sandy-mud bottoms and are an excellent bait for any small- to medium-sized saltwater fish: from Atlantic Saury and Mackerel to Haddock and Whiting.

name: Black Lugworms
description: Black Lugworms . Large worms that can grow over 30 cm long and live on sandy beaches. Bigger and rarer than the common lugworms, they're considered the best of their kind for attracting saltwater predators, including European Sea Sturgeon and cod-family species such as Haddock and Cusk.

name: Peeler Crab
description: Peeler Crab . Fresh from shedding its shell, this soft-bodied crab is a tender, nutritious, and easy-to-digest treat for fish. It's usually cut into pieces and tied to the hook with thread to keep it secure, making it perfect for all Cod-like fish, Flatfish, Sturgeon, and especially Atlantic Wolffish.

name: Razor Shell
description: Razor Shell . Razor Shell is a long, narrow clam found in the sandy shallows of northern coasts. Its soft flesh is rich in scent and nutrients, making it highly attractive to a range of saltwater species such as Haddock, Whiting, Cusk, and Atlantic Wolffish.

name: Candy
description: Candy . Here, fishy fishy...Trick or treat! These Halloween pumpkin jellies are just the perfect bait to liven up that holiday spirit and awaken your inner child as you go on a night hunt after monstrous bony anomalies that find pumpkin Candy simply irresistible!

name: Sour Bread
description: Sour Bread . Ugh, this is the kind of pastry you don’t ever want to try! Nevertheless, it appears that Halloween monsters and ordinary fish alike seem to find this bait extremely attractive.

name: Moldy Cheese
description: Moldy Cheese . This is neither Dorblu, nor Gorgonzola, and most definitely not Roquefort! Just your ordinary cheese that got old and moldy over time. Looks disgusting, smells even worse. But will work great as bait for all fish, including Halloween monsters!

name: Drunken Worm
description: Drunken Worm . This party animal is one fun live bait to fish with. Apparently green in color from drinking too much green beer, this shamrock critter is wild and out of control but just with the right attitude for attracting the Leprechaun Fish!

name: Bully Grasshopper
description: The unique Bully Grasshopper is not only a unique collectible bait that is versatile and useful for catching numerous fish. This St.Patrick’s Day bug is an ultimately attractive treat for the feisty Rowdy Bass.

name: Dried Locusts
description: Dried Locusts . Looking at these creepy overgrown grasshoppers, you can only feel relieved that they are dead and dry. Let’s hope we never encounter these critters in their swarming phase. Nonetheless, awesome bait that works great for all fish, including Halloween monsters!

name: Candy Wax Worms
description: Candy Wax Worms . A special bait for a special fish! Only on Christmas, you can get special Christmas baits for decorated fish. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated White Crappie.

name: Marmalade Red Worms
description: Marmalade Red Worms . A special bait for a special fish! Only on Christmas, you can get special Christmas baits for decorated fish. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Prussian Carp.

name: Dead Mice
description: Dead Mice . This limited-time Halloween bait is great for catching all Gars and Catfish. Not to mention that the spooky Monster Gars will find it delicious!

name: Pig's Eye
description: Pig's Eye . This freaky limited-time bait is a Halloween offer that's just perfect for catching all Gars and Catfish. Not to mention that the spooky Monster Gars will find it especially delicious!

name: Rotten Minnows
description: Rotten Minnows . This is a limited-time offer available only on Halloween. The most effective bait for catching all Gars and Catfish. But most importantly, it attracts those scary Halloween Gars like no other!

name: Frozen Cutbait
description: Frozen Cutbait . Cutbait is natural bait, one catfish immediately recognize as food in a natural sense. A small fillet from a large baitfish makes great cutbait for catfish and smaller species. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Channel Catfish.

name: Frozen Shiners
description: Frozen Shiners . Shiners are regarded by many fishermen as one of the most effective baits. It's the perfect choice for catching multiple game fish like pike, bass, salmon, trout and gar. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Longnose Gar.

name: Frozen Minnows
description: Frozen Minnows . Minnows are regarded by many fishermen as one of the most effective baits. It's the perfect choice for catching multiple game fish like pike, bass or gar. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Alligator Gar.

name: Glazing crawfish
description: These well-cut Glazing crawfish will spread the tasty scent in the water to attract fish. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated White Sturgeon.

name: Caramel Chunks
description: Caramel Chunks . This special fishing bait is the ultimate choice for carp fishing, particularly when going after Bighead Carp and Silver Carp. This is the most effective bait for catching Decorated Silver Carp.

name: Baby-Buffalo
description: Baby-Buffalo . They say that the Snakehead eats everything. But something really drives it crazy, forcing to rush to the bait. This little buffalo is a big temptation for a clever predator.

name: Baby-Catfish
description: Baby-Catfish . We don't know why the Snakeheads react so much to a baby catfish. Maybe they can't resist its adorable whiskers. In any case, this is one of the best bait for hunting Snakehead.

name: Clown Frog
description: Clown Frog . In a muddy pond, not that much entertainment, you know. So, Snakehead just can not miss the fun performance of the Clown Frog. Choose it as bait and see how quickly Snakehead reacts at its orange bubbles!

name: Skull Bait
description: Skull Bait . This unique bait is made entirely out of fish heads! It took catching and beheading five American Shads to prepare this skullful treat, and the head-hungry Eldergar will find it irresistible!

name: Zombie Bait
description: Zombie Bait . Made of undigested dead bird hatchlings that were found in the intestines of large Gars, this is easily the most gruesome and horrific bait ever used for catching Cats. However, it is probably the only bait disgusting enough to match and catch the no less abominable Zombie Cat!

name: Caviar Bait
description: Caviar Bait . This special bait is made out of a variety of Salmon Eggs taken from every kind of Salmon caught in the Kaniq Creek. Using such an exquisite dish as bait is your only hope of catching every last Albino Blackfish - fierce little mutants that are endangering the local population of Salmon.

name: Voodoo Shells
description: Voodoo Shells . This special bait is made out of molluscs from the Shells found at the bottom of lake White Moose and is exactly what Native American shamans used to summon the Voodoo Fish hundreds of years ago. Perhaps without the proper spells and rituals these Voodoo Shells are devoid of any magical powers, but their distinctive smell should definitely be enough to lure the wise old monster from its underwater hideout.

name: Bassy Bait
description: Bassy Bait . This live bait made out of freshly caught Largemouth Bass is meant for catching the Terror Tarpon, who seems to have a particular taste for these fish. With the brutal monster ruthlessly killing off one Largemouth after another, making this bait out 5 small fish seemed like a reasonable sacrifice the sake of saving the entire Bass population!

name: Brown Trout Eggs
description: Brown Trout Eggs . Almost any fish would love to get a taste of a first-class bait like Brown Trout Eggs. However, this yummy treat is meant for one particularly large, genetically modified organism known as the Rainbow Outlaw. After all, this scaly fugitive is a picky eater and won’t settle for anything less!

name: Frankenbait
description: Frankenbait . Made out of a variety of fresh Pike meat, this unique first-grade cutbait looks like a gourmet dish from a restaurant...or a prop from a Frankenstein movie. However you see it, Frankebait would be a yummy treat for the pickiest underwater predator, particularly, the Pike-hungry vengeful Walleye, better known as the Pikeslasher!

name: Ginger Cookies
description: Each housewife has her own recipe for festive pastry. But there is one universal recipe – it’s the beloved Ginger Cookies ! As soon as they come out of the oven, neither human nor fish can resist their pull. You simply won’t rest until you have one.

name: Buñuelos
description: Incredible winter delicacy: tender, spongy, hot pumpkin doughnuts, here to warm your hearts and stir up interest in the fish, who are keen to get some Christmas warmth. Even the bearded Bandit Aracu is ready to put his mischievous manner aside and get a couple of Buñuelos for tea!

name: Cookies with Milk
description: Cookies with Milk . What an absolute delight: to dunk a cookie in milk and eat it before it melts! It’s not only people who love it, fish are crazy about it too! Especially the Dunce Crappie, who is ready to jump out of the water for this treat.

name: Turdilli
description: Turdilli . A family recipe from your beloved Italian grandma. Deep fried wine-soaked honey cookies! They melt both in your mouth and in your hands, so you better put one on the hook and cast the rod. This dessert attracts sweet-toothed fish, and the Foolish Goby won’t keep you waiting!

name: Stollen
description: Stollen . The traditional stollen is made a month before Christmas and is left to age, soaking in the decadent flavors of melted butter and candied peel. Even a tiny bite of this dessert is likely to attract a large fish! Maybe even a certain old Eel, who has managed to steal something from Santa himself...

name: Candy Cane
description: Candy Cane . It’s impossible to imagine a Christmas tree without this traditional sweet decoration! This stripy candy looks like a cane and a hook at the same time. It comes as no surprise that such a lure can attract fish of all shapes and sizes. Even the Crumbling Krampus Payara doesn’t mind tasting this festive delicious cane!

name: Eel Doll Bait
description: Eel Doll Bait . This unique bait is made from silicone to imitate live Eels! It's the only way to catch Cannibal Eel with no harm to the protected species!

name: Drowned Mouse
description: Drowned Mouse . This unique bait is made out of drowned mice collected in the lake. It's the best thing to use for catching the Black Whisker!

name: Pickled Jauari Palm Fruit
description: Pickled Jauari Palm Fruit If the juicy fruits of the Jauari palm are pickled according to grandma's recipe, you get an incredible beer snack and a wonderful bait for fruitarian fish like the Buzzman Tambaqui.

description: Infernal Crab Ancient druid knowledge says this special bait attracts spirits and demons from otherworldly reality that got into fish.

name: Golden Corn
description: Gorgeous large kernels of Golden Corn are without a doubt the best fish bait. Most freshwater dwellers, from Trout to Sunfish, are partial to corn. Keep in mind that this simple bait is great for attracting big fish and will guarantee the angler a successful catch!

name: Mutant Lobster
description: Mutant Lobster is a unique bait that has undergone an amazing mutation turning it into a living kaleidoscope. The Mutant Lobster emits a bright shimmering light that can attract and mesmerize deep-sea monsters, making it the perfect bait for hunting Grouperzilla.

name: Suttungr’s Mead
description: Suttungr’s Mead . This special bait, made from secret ingredients, pressed and dried under pressure, like a mythical drink, provokes berserker rage in the Armored Bighead.

name: Pig's heart
description: Pig's heart . Truly disgusting! A raw, bloody pig organ is the perfect bait for the Slide-Rock Bolter, which can smell fresh meat from afar.
